description: Four balls bouncing around a box, each sending its position out and a trigger every time it strikes a wall

params.text: Puts that ball back in the middle of the box at its starting speed
Speeds that ball up by the amount its VELX and VELY knobs are set to
Sets how fast that ball travels left and right, positive to the right
Sets how fast that ball travels up and down, positive downwards
Multiplies the speed that ball is given when it is triggered
Adds -5V to +5V to every X output
Adds -5V to +5V to every Y output
Shows and hides the white pad the balls can strike

inputs.text: A trigger here puts that ball back in the middle of the box
A trigger here speeds that ball up
Sets how fast that ball travels left and right in place of its knob
Sets how fast that ball travels up and down in place of its knob
Multiplies the speed that ball is given when it is triggered, in place of its knob
Sets where the white pad is from side to side, 0V to 10V
Sets where the white pad is from top to bottom, 0V to 10V

outputs.text: How far across the box that ball is, scaled and offset by the SCL X and OFST X knobs
How far down the box that ball is, scaled and offset by the SCL Y and OFST Y knobs
A trigger each time that ball strikes the top of the box
A trigger each time that ball strikes the right-hand side of the box
A trigger each time that ball strikes the bottom of the box
A trigger each time that ball strikes the left-hand side of the box
A trigger each time that ball strikes any side of the box
A trigger each time that ball strikes the white pad

notes: clicking the dark area locks and unlocks the pad, so it can be dragged with the mouse
menu: Gate Length — sets how long the strike triggers last, in milliseconds
